candidate_design.validation: Raw input must be exact built-in bytes. Expected external SHA256 and filename checked. Bounded central parsing before ZipFile allocation, bounded decompression, fixed metadata and exact entrypoint bytes, complete unique bidirectional RECORD coverage with canonical SHA256+decimal size. Only exact self-record has empty hash/size.
candidate_design.token: Sealed factory-only normal API; immutable filename/digest/size/member tuples and exact immutable raw-byte storage. No public setters. Python private-state/object.__setattr__ tampering is explicitly outside the declared threat model.
candidate_design.reader: Custom named seekable object, not mutable BytesIO or a subclass thereof. No buffer protocol, public writable getbuffer, mutable returned memory view or file descriptor. readinto only copies outward. name is read-only; getvalue returns immutable bytes and consumes read allowance.
candidate_design.read_budget: Explicit caller-supplied exact ReadBudget, maximum64MiB, shared by validation and all token streams. Charge raw input hashing, compressed stream transfers and declared decompressed members before reading; no automatic fresh budget on open/seek. Exhaustion is sticky. Reprocessing already fetched immutable metadata/hash bytes is not separately counted as filesystem IO; CPU/allocation/work remain under caller's outer caps.
candidate_design.authority_limit: This local accounting object does not establish run authority or replace the future harness's global file/read/write limits. A caller could create another explicit budget; the qualified harness must govern invocation totals.
